_comment: Phase 10 item 10: larger semantic paraphrase test (>=100 examples). mfa_verification_intent/credential_intent mix known phrasing (canonical trigger words) with paraphrases that avoid them entirely. benign_security_context mentions the same vocabulary while explicitly NOT requesting the secret (warnings/policy/confirmations) -- the distinguishing test this file targets: requesting a secret vs. discussing why secrets must not be shared. benign_other is unrelated everyday text, for baseline FPR breadth. Not used for training or threshold selection.
